title: The statistical threshold for planted matchings and spanning trees
summary: In this paper, we study the problem of detecting the presence of a planted perfect matching or spanning tree in an Erdős--Rényi random graph. More precisely, we study the hypothesis testing problem where the statistician observes a graph on $n$ vertices. Under the null hypothesis, the graph is a realization of an Erdős--Rényi random graph $G(n,q)$, while under the alternative hypothesis, the graph is the union of an Erdős--Rényi random graph and a random perfect matching (or random spanning tree).
